Garage Manager.lua.author: epic_ninja454
Garage Manager.lua.description: Vehicle Manager (EE) — press F6 to open. A full garage inventory manager for GTA Online Enhanced. Browse garages and vehicles, inspect installed mods, and disambiguate cars with plates plus a pannable 3D preview. New update: the 3D preview is now built in instead of a separate preview script, and vehicles can be deleted permanently with a confirmation dialog. Also includes vehicle search by name, drag and drop between garages to rearrange or swap, GTA+ entitlement checks before writing to the Vinewood Club garage, a one-click claim for destroyed cars via the Vinewood app, confirmation prompts, and ambiguous-write safety locks. It ain't much but it's definitely better than the Manage Vehicles menu. More on the way.
